Tess Morgan: Heads-up — scheduling a 'fallthrough surge check' for client Nimbus' reserved pool (nimbus-resv-21) Tue 23:00 UTC. Objective: validate fallthrough routing to cheaper model variants + quota fallback behavior under mixed traffic. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/fallthrough-surge-check :boom:
Caleb Ortiz: I can run the harness. Plan: long-tail gen at 4k rps + repeated chat spikes to 30k rps (45s) with random pauses. Will tag requests X-fallthrough:3198765432 and include scenario=gen/chat/embed headers. Push to infra/loadtests/nimbus/branch by EOD.
Yvonne Park: I'll watch fallthrough router logs, model-switch events, and per-tenant throttle counters. If fallthrough rate >30% for 5m we escalate. Which tools for load?
Tess Morgan: k6 for sustained gen + hey for short burst chat. Disable KV warmers to exercise KV cold paths. Example k6 snippet:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function(){
  http.post('https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'seed '+Math.random()}), {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer $TEST', 'X-Fallthrough': '3198765432'}});
  sleep(0.04);
}
```
Marcus Hill: I'll own rollback and quota knobs. Rollback play: 1) flip fallthrough=false, 2) re-route to primary model shard, 3) set quota cap to 'reserve-hold-60pct' and scale nodes by -25%. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
infra-bot: Preflight: pool=nimbus-resv-21, GPUs=30, headroom=15%, infra tickets clear.
Caleb Ortiz: Dry-run request: can we do Wed 21:00 UTC 10m smoke to validate certs? Customer OK'd short dry-run. Also note: harness will inject 3% malformed prompts to exercise error handling and include slow-client emulation.
Yvonne Park: Temp alerts I'll set: "sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1m])) by (pool) > 5000" and "increase(redwood_fallthrough_total[5m]) > 1000". I'll add dashboard annotations and a short runbook link in the alert.
Tess Morgan: Timeline: Wed dry-run 21:00 (10m) -> Tue 23:00 canary 5m -> 23:05 ramp 23:05-23:40 -> 23:40 cooldown + samples. Roles: Caleb=load, Yvonne=monitor, Marcus=rollback, Tess=customer ops/orchestration.
Marcus Hill: Also prepare the 'graceful-queue' policy — if median queue >60s for 2m we enable queue-throttle and reduce embed priority. I'll pre-stage the k8s drain scripts and a one-click rollback in the console.
Caleb Ortiz: I'll ensure X-test-run and scenario headers for slicing, and produce a CSV of per-verb latencies. Will merge harness branch by noon. KV caching disabled in harness.
Tess Morgan: Post-run: auto-sample 400 outputs per workload and run the quality regression job. If we see >1% regression in gen quality we'll hold the customer follow-up and flag renewal risk in the account note.
Yvonne Park: I'll schedule the collector to run at 23:45 and export metrics to s3://redwood-test-runs/nimbus/3198765432.
Tess Morgan: Final pre-checks: 1) disable warmers, 2) push temp alerts, 3) set quota policy 'fallthrough-cap-70pct', 4) merge harness branch. We'll confirm readiness here 2h before each window. Thanks all — see you on Zoom. :rocket:
